Basis for Intervening:
Pursuant to Rules 212 and 214 of the Rules of Practice and Procedure of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (“Commission”), 18 C.F.R. §§ 385.212 and 385.214, SE DC DevCo, LLC, PORTS 2 Interconnect, LLC, and Portsmouth Gas DevCo, LLC (collectively, “SB Energy”) hereby move to intervene in this proceeding. SB Energy is a SoftBank Group Company. SB Energy’s mission is to enable the new AI economy by developing, building, and owning its critical physical infrastructure, including large-scale power generation and data center infrastructure.  SB Energy is developing both the data center facilities and generation resources in the Flagship Project, and subject to necessary regulatory approvals will solely bear the cost of new transmission infrastructure necessary for the Flagship Project.  SB Energy has a direct and substantial interest in the outcome of this proceeding, and its interests cannot be adequately represented by any other party. Accordingly, SB Energy respectfully requests that the Commission grant its motion to intervene in this proceeding.
